Blue Satin Blouse & White Peonies

Romantic, painterly, cool
WORKING NOTES
- Mixing satin and lace is the key texture contrast.
- Swap the peonies for dried flowers for a moodier version.
Try this: Swap the peonies for dried flowers.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight
jet-black hair and pale skin holds a large bouquet of
white peonies at her waist. She wears a deep blue
satin high-necked blouse with covered buttons and
full sleeves with lace cuffs, plus a slim silver
bracelet. Her expression is calm and direct against
a plain pale gray seamless backdrop. Soft, diffused
window light, a cool palette of cornflower blue, ivory
white, and jet black. Romantic and painterly, in the
style of a classical fine-art portrait.
